title: Epicurean
summary: EPICU'REAN EPICURE'AN, adjective [Latin epicureus.] Pertaining to Epicurus; as the epicurean philosophy or tenets. 1. Luxurious; given to luxury; contributing to the luxuries of the table. EPICU'REAN

inlines.v: EPICU'REAN EPICURE'AN, adjective [Latin epicureus.] Pertaining to Epicurus; as the epicurean philosophy or tenets. 1. Luxurious; given to luxury; contributing to the luxuries of the table. EPICU'REAN EPICURE'AN, noun A follower of Epicurus.
